sources.title: Piracy monthly report September 2025
sources.text: Duty AB onboard a berthed ship spotted three robbers armed with knives emerging from the engine room. One robber attempted to attack the duty crew, who quickly retreated and informed the duty officer. Three additional robbers were seen disembarking via the gangway. Despite the crew's vigilance, the robbers escape with stolen ship's properties. The incident was reported to Port Facility Security Officer.
